questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Genre?

options.text: It is a category of films sharing recognisable themes, styles, and narrative conventions.
It is a familiar element that audiences expect within a particular genre.
It is a style of crime film marked by cynicism, deep shadow, and fatalism.
It is a genre emphasising intense emotion and heightened personal conflicts.

questions.explanation: It is a category of films sharing recognisable themes, styles, and narrative conventions. This is precisely what Genre means; the alternatives describe Convention, Film noir, Melodrama, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Genre.
